passages.text: And I looked and saw above the expanse, above the heads of the cherubim, the likeness of a throne of sapphire.
passages.sermon:
Ezekiel is the prophet who is speaking.
Ezekiel looked up.
He saw an expanse above the heads of the cherubim.
Cherubim are powerful angelic beings.
Above this expanse, Ezekiel saw something.
He saw something that looked like a throne.
The throne looked like it was made of sapphire stone.
The throne appeared above the cherubim.
passages.original: וָאֶרְאֶ֗ה וְהִנֵּ֤ה אֶל־ הָרָקִ֙יעַ֙ אֲשֶׁר֙ עַל־ רֹ֣אשׁ הַכְּרֻבִ֔ים כְּאֶ֣בֶן סַפִּ֔יר כְּמַרְאֵ֖ה דְּמ֣וּת כִּסֵּ֑א נִרְאָ֖ה עֲלֵיהֶֽם׃

passages.text: And the LORD said to the man clothed in linen, “Go inside the wheelwork beneath the cherubim. Fill your hands with burning coals from among the cherubim and scatter them over the city.” And as I watched, he went in.
passages.sermon:
The LORD spoke to the man.
This man wore linen clothes.
The LORD gave him a command.
The LORD said, “Go inside the wheelwork beneath the cherubim.
Fill your hands with burning coals from among the cherubim.
Scatter the coals over the city.”
I watched the man.
He went in as the LORD commanded.
passages.original: וַיֹּ֜אמֶר אֶל־ הָאִ֣ישׁ׀ לְבֻ֣שׁ הַבַּדִּ֗ים וַיֹּ֡אמֶר בֹּא֩ אֶל־ בֵּינ֨וֹת לַגַּלְגַּ֜ל אֶל־ תַּ֣חַת לַכְּר֗וּב וּמַלֵּ֨א חָפְנֶ֤יךָ גַֽחֲלֵי־ אֵשׁ֙ מִבֵּינ֣וֹת לַכְּרֻבִ֔ים וּזְרֹ֖ק עַל־ הָעִ֑יר וַיָּבֹ֖א לְעֵינָֽי׃

passages.text: Now when the man went in, the cherubim were standing on the south side of the temple, and a cloud filled the inner court.
passages.sermon: The man entered the temple.\r\nThe cherubim stood on the south side of the temple.\r\nA cloud filled the inner court.
passages.original: וְהַכְּרֻבִ֗ים עֹֽמְדִ֛ים מִימִ֥ין לַבַּ֖יִת בְּבֹא֣וֹ הָאִ֑ישׁ וְהֶעָנָ֣ן מָלֵ֔א אֶת־ הֶחָצֵ֖ר הַפְּנִימִֽית׃

passages.text: Then the glory of the LORD rose from above the cherubim and stood over the threshold of the temple. The temple was filled with the cloud, and the court was filled with the brightness of the glory of the LORD.
passages.sermon:
The glory of the LORD rose from above the cherubim.
The glory of the LORD stood over the threshold of the temple.
A cloud filled the temple.
The brightness of the glory of the LORD filled the court.
passages.original: וַיָּ֤רָם כְּבוֹד־ יְהוָה֙ מֵעַ֣ל הַכְּר֔וּב עַ֖ל מִפְתַּ֣ן הַבָּ֑יִת וַיִּמָּלֵ֤א הַבַּ֙יִת֙ אֶת־ הֶ֣עָנָ֔ן וְהֶֽחָצֵר֙ מָֽלְאָ֔ה אֶת־ נֹ֖גַהּ כְּב֥וֹד יְהוָֽה׃

passages.text: The sound of the wings of the cherubim could be heard as far as the outer court, like the voice of God Almighty when He speaks.
passages.sermon:
Cherubim are mighty heavenly beings.
They have wings.
The wings of the cherubim made a sound.
People could hear this sound far away.
The sound reached the outer court.
The sound was very powerful.
The sound was like the voice of God Almighty when He speaks.
passages.original: וְקוֹל֙ כַּנְפֵ֣י הַכְּרוּבִ֔ים נִשְׁמַ֕ע עַד־ הֶחָצֵ֖ר הַחִיצֹנָ֑ה כְּק֥וֹל אֵל־ שַׁדַּ֖י בְּדַבְּרֽוֹ׃

passages.text: When the LORD commanded the man clothed in linen, saying, “Take fire from within the wheelwork, from among the cherubim,” the man went in and stood beside a wheel.
passages.sermon:
The LORD spoke to the man.
The man wore linen clothes.
The LORD gave a command to the man.
He said, "Take fire from inside the wheelwork."
The fire was among the cherubim.
The man obeyed the LORD.
He went in.
He stood beside a wheel.
passages.original: וַיְהִ֗י בְּצַוֺּתוֹ֙ אֶת־ הָאִ֤ישׁ לְבֻֽשׁ־ הַבַּדִּים֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר קַ֥ח אֵשׁ֙ מִבֵּינ֣וֹת לַגַּלְגַּ֔ל מִבֵּינ֖וֹת לַכְּרוּבִ֑ים וַיָּבֹא֙ וַֽיַּעֲמֹ֔ד אֵ֖צֶל הָאוֹפָֽן׃

passages.text: Then one of the cherubim reached out his hand and took some of the fire that was among them. And he put it into the hands of the man clothed in linen, who received it and went out.
passages.sermon:
A cherub is a heavenly being with wings.
One cherub reached out his hand.
He reached between the other cherubim.
He took fire that was among the cherubim.
He put the fire into the hands of the man dressed in linen.
The man dressed in linen took the fire.
The man dressed in linen went out.
passages.original: וַיִּשְׁלַח֩ הַכְּר֨וּב אֶת־ יָד֜וֹ מִבֵּינ֣וֹת לַכְּרוּבִ֗ים אֶל־ הָאֵשׁ֙ אֲשֶׁר֙ בֵּינ֣וֹת הַכְּרֻבִ֔ים וַיִּשָּׂא֙ וַיִּתֵּ֔ן אֶל־ חָפְנֵ֖י לְבֻ֣שׁ הַבַּדִּ֑ים וַיִּקַּ֖ח וַיֵּצֵֽא׃

passages.text: (The cherubim appeared to have the form of human hands under their wings.)
passages.sermon:
The cherubim are powerful angelic beings.
\r\nEach cherub has wings.
\r\nUnder their wings, the cherubim have something special.
\r\nThey have the form of human hands under their wings.
\r\nThese hands look like the hands of a man.
passages.original: וַיֵּרָ֖א לַכְּרֻבִ֑ים תַּבְנִית֙ יַד־ אָדָ֔ם תַּ֖חַת כַּנְפֵיהֶֽם׃

passages.text: Then I looked and saw four wheels beside the cherubim, one wheel beside each cherub. And the wheels gleamed like a beryl stone.
passages.sermon:
The prophet Ezekiel saw a vision.
He saw four cherubim.
Each cherub was a powerful angelic being.
Ezekiel looked beside the cherubim.
He saw four wheels.
Each wheel stood beside one cherub.
The wheels shone brightly.
The wheels gleamed like beryl stone.
passages.original: וָאֶרְאֶ֗ה וְהִנֵּ֨ה אַרְבָּעָ֣ה אוֹפַנִּים֮ אֵ֣צֶל הַכְּרוּבִים֒ אוֹפַ֣ן אֶחָ֗ד אֵ֚צֶל הַכְּר֣וּב אֶחָ֔ד וְאוֹפַ֣ן אֶחָ֔ד אֵ֖צֶל הַכְּר֣וּב אֶחָ֑ד וּמַרְאֵה֙ הָא֣וֹפַנִּ֔ים כְּעֵ֖ין אֶ֥בֶן תַּרְשִֽׁישׁ׃

passages.text: As for their appearance, all four had the same form, like a wheel within a wheel.
passages.sermon:
The prophet Ezekiel saw four cherubim.
Each cherub had a wheel beside it.
All four wheels looked the same.
Each wheel had the same shape and design.
Each wheel looked like a wheel inside another wheel.
passages.original: וּמַ֨רְאֵיהֶ֔ם דְּמ֥וּת אֶחָ֖ד לְאַרְבַּעְתָּ֑ם כַּאֲשֶׁ֛ר יִהְיֶ֥ה הָאוֹפַ֖ן בְּת֥וֹךְ הָאוֹפָֽן׃

passages.text: When they moved, they would go in any of the four directions, without turning as they moved. For wherever the head faced, the cherubim would go in that direction, without turning as they moved.
passages.sermon:
The cherubim are heavenly beings.
The cherubim have four wheels beside them.
The cherubim can move in any of the four directions.
The cherubim do not turn as they move.
The cherubim always go where the head faces.
The cherubim do not turn as they move.
passages.original: בְּלֶכְתָּ֗ם אֶל־ אַרְבַּ֤עַת רִבְעֵיהֶם֙ יֵלֵ֔כוּ לֹ֥א יִסַּ֖בּוּ בְּלֶכְתָּ֑ם כִּ֣י הַמָּק֞וֹם אֲשֶׁר־ יִפְנֶ֤ה הָרֹאשׁ֙ אַחֲרָ֣יו יֵלֵ֔כוּ לֹ֥א יִסַּ֖בּוּ בְּלֶכְתָּֽם׃

passages.text: Their entire bodies, including their backs, hands, and wings, were full of eyes all around, as were their four wheels.
passages.sermon:
The cherubim had bodies.
Their bodies were covered with eyes.
Their backs had eyes.
Their hands had eyes.
Their wings had eyes.
Each of their four wheels had eyes all around.
The eyes covered every part.
passages.original: וְכָל־ בְּשָׂרָם֙ וְגַבֵּהֶ֔ם וִֽידֵיהֶ֖ם וְכַנְפֵיהֶ֑ם וְהָאֽוֹפַנִּ֗ים מְלֵאִ֤ים עֵינַ֙יִם֙ סָבִ֔יב לְאַרְבַּעְתָּ֖ם אוֹפַנֵּיהֶֽם׃

passages.text: I heard the wheels being called “the whirling wheels.”
passages.sermon: The prophet Ezekiel saw a vision by the River Kebar.\r\nHe saw cherubim with wheels beside them.\r\nI heard someone call the wheels “the whirling wheels.”
passages.original: לָא֖וֹפַנִּ֑ים לָהֶ֛ם קוֹרָ֥א הַגַּלְגַּ֖ל בְּאָזְנָֽי׃

passages.text: Each of the cherubim had four faces: the first face was that of a cherub, the second that of a man, the third that of a lion, and the fourth that of an eagle.
passages.sermon:
Each cherub was a living creature.
Each cherub had four faces.
The first face was the face of a cherub.
The second face was the face of a man.
The third face was the face of a lion.
The fourth face was the face of an eagle.
passages.original: וְאַרְבָּעָ֥ה פָנִ֖ים לְאֶחָ֑ד פְּנֵ֨י הָאֶחָ֜ד פְּנֵ֣י הַכְּר֗וּב וּפְנֵ֤י הַשֵּׁנִי֙ פְּנֵ֣י אָדָ֔ם וְהַשְּׁלִישִׁי֙ פְּנֵ֣י אַרְיֵ֔ה וְהָרְבִיעִ֖י פְּנֵי־ נָֽשֶׁר׃

passages.text: Then the cherubim rose upward. These were the living creatures I had seen by the River Kebar.
passages.sermon: The cherubim are living creatures.\r\nI saw these living creatures by the River Kebar.\r\nThe cherubim rose upward.
passages.original: וַיֵּרֹ֖מּוּ הַכְּרוּבִ֑ים הִ֣יא הַחַיָּ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר רָאִ֖יתִי בִּֽנְהַר־ כְּבָֽר׃

passages.text: When the cherubim moved, the wheels moved beside them, and even when they spread their wings to rise from the ground, the wheels did not veer away from their side.
passages.sermon:
The cherubim are powerful angelic beings.
Each cherub has four faces.
The cherubim have wings.
The cherubim move.
Wheels move beside the cherubim.
The cherubim spread their wings.
The cherubim rise from the ground.
The wheels stay beside the cherubim.
The wheels do not turn away from the cherubim.
passages.original: וּבְלֶ֙כֶת֙ הַכְּרוּבִ֔ים יֵלְכ֥וּ הָאוֹפַנִּ֖ים אֶצְלָ֑ם וּבִשְׂאֵ֨ת הַכְּרוּבִ֜ים אֶת־ כַּנְפֵיהֶ֗ם לָרוּם֙ מֵעַ֣ל הָאָ֔רֶץ לֹא־ יִסַּ֧בּוּ הָאוֹפַנִּ֛ים גַּם־ הֵ֖ם מֵאֶצְלָֽם׃

passages.text: When the cherubim stood still, the wheels also stood still, and when they ascended, the wheels ascended with them, for the spirit of the living creatures was in the wheels.
passages.sermon:
The cherubim are powerful heavenly beings.
The cherubim have living spirits within them.
When the cherubim stood still, the wheels stood still.
When the cherubim rose upward, the wheels rose with them.
The spirit of the living creatures was in the wheels.
passages.original: בְּעָמְדָ֣ם יַעֲמֹ֔דוּ וּבְרוֹמָ֖ם יֵר֣וֹמּוּ אוֹתָ֑ם כִּ֛י ר֥וּחַ הַחַיָּ֖ה בָּהֶֽם׃

passages.text: Then the glory of the LORD moved away from the threshold of the temple and stood above the cherubim.
passages.sermon: The glory of the LORD left the threshold of the temple.\r\nThe glory of the LORD stood above the cherubim.
passages.original: וַיֵּצֵא֙ כְּב֣וֹד יְהוָ֔ה מֵעַ֖ל מִפְתַּ֣ן הַבָּ֑יִת וַֽיַּעֲמֹ֖ד עַל־ הַכְּרוּבִֽים׃

passages.text: As I watched, the cherubim lifted their wings and rose up from the ground, with the wheels beside them as they went. And they stopped at the entrance of the east gate of the house of the LORD, with the glory of the God of Israel above them.
passages.sermon:
The cherubim are powerful angelic beings.
They lifted their wings.
They rose up from the ground.
I saw them as they went up.
The wheels moved beside the cherubim.
The cherubim stopped at the entrance of the east gate of the house of the LORD.
The glory of the God of Israel was above the cherubim.
passages.original: וַיִּשְׂא֣וּ הַכְּרוּבִ֣ים אֶת־ כַּ֠נְפֵיהֶם וַיֵּר֨וֹמּוּ מִן־ הָאָ֤רֶץ לְעֵינַי֙ בְּצֵאתָ֔ם וְהָאֽוֹפַנִּ֖ים לְעֻמָּתָ֑ם וַֽיַּעֲמֹ֗ד פֶּ֣תַח שַׁ֤עַר בֵּית־ יְהוָה֙ הַקַּדְמוֹנִ֔י וּכְב֧וֹד אֱלֹהֵֽי־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל עֲלֵיהֶ֖ם מִלְמָֽעְלָה׃

passages.text: These were the living creatures I had seen beneath the God of Israel by the River Kebar, and I knew that they were cherubim.
passages.sermon:
Ezekiel saw living creatures.
He saw them beneath the God of Israel.
He saw them by the River Kebar.
Ezekiel recognized these creatures.
He knew they were cherubim.
passages.original: הִ֣יא הַחַיָּ֗ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר רָאִ֛יתִי תַּ֥חַת אֱלֹהֵֽי־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל בִּֽנְהַר־ כְּבָ֑ר וָאֵדַ֕ע כִּ֥י כְרוּבִ֖ים הֵֽמָּה׃

passages.text: Each had four faces and four wings, with what looked like human hands under their wings.
passages.sermon:
The cherubim are living creatures.
Each cherub had four faces.
Each cherub had four wings.
Each cherub had something that looked like human hands under its wings.
passages.original: אַרְבָּעָ֨ה אַרְבָּעָ֤ה פָנִים֙ לְאֶחָ֔ד וְאַרְבַּ֥ע כְּנָפַ֖יִם לְאֶחָ֑ד וּדְמוּת֙ יְדֵ֣י אָדָ֔ם תַּ֖חַת כַּנְפֵיהֶֽם׃

passages.text: Their faces looked like the faces I had seen by the River Kebar. Each creature went straight ahead.
passages.sermon:
Ezekiel saw living creatures.
These creatures were cherubim.
Each cherub had faces.
Their faces looked the same as the faces Ezekiel saw by the River Kebar.
Each cherub moved straight ahead.
passages.original: וּדְמ֣וּת פְּנֵיהֶ֔ם הֵ֣מָּה הַפָּנִ֗ים אֲשֶׁ֤ר רָאִ֙יתִי֙ עַל־ נְהַר־ כְּבָ֔ר מַרְאֵיהֶ֖ם וְאוֹתָ֑ם אִ֛ישׁ אֶל־ עֵ֥בֶר פָּנָ֖יו יֵלֵֽכוּ׃
